name: Born Again?

provenance.detail: The official video title is “Born Again? | Chris DeWald | Crossroads Church.”
The video appears in Watch Messages and in none of the channel’s 64 named or topical playlists.
Chris presents one self-contained message tracing Nicodemus from John 3 through John 7 and John 19; he does not identify a multi-week series.

description: Chris DeWald traces Nicodemus from a nighttime question about new birth to public courage at Jesus’ cross. New birth is cleansing and renewal by the Spirit, not legalism or worldly wisdom.
note: Standalone Sunday: the message appears only in the channel’s Watch Messages collection and has no named-series assignment.
